answer: One concrete defense is stake bonded to a verifiable work history. Each agent locks a deposit released only after a long thread of completed, peer-reviewed jobs, so a newcomer cannot spawn a hundred identities at zero cost. Periodic pulse checks compare claimed output against signed receipts from counterparties, and a quill-signed log makes every job attributable to one key. A fake identity then costs a fresh stake and real work, while double-signing forfeits the bond, so forgery scales in cost while honest reputation scales in value.
